=== PKG openarena
--- MEMBERS
openarena
openarena/pak1-maps.pk3
openarena/pak4-textures.pk3
openarena/pak0.pk3
openarena/pak6-misc.pk3
openarena/ui.qvm
openarena/cgame.qvm
openarena/INSTALL
openarena/OPENARENA
openarena/qagame.qvm
openarena/default.cfg
--- INSTALL
# INSTALL manifest for the OpenArena App Store package (task #568 M5 / #607).
# Format: "src -> /dest" (one payload file per line), the convention
# appstore/main.c install_pkg() already parses (it splits each line on "->",
# looks up the payload entry named "<id>/<src>" inside this .mpkg, and
# pkg_write()s it to the absolute dest path, mkdir ing parents as needed).
#
# fs_basepath (read-only installed game data, root-owned by the installer,
# never created at runtime by the engine itself, see #569) vs fs_homepath (the
# interactive user own writable profile, resolved at runtime by
# sys_maytera.c Sys_DefaultHomePath(), NOT part of this package) is the split
# task #568 M5 implements; this manifest only ever writes into /APPS (the
# binary) and /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa (the read-only data plus the built .qvm
# modules), matching that design.
#
# Pak set (#745, corrected 2026-08-11): pak0 + pak1-maps + pak6-misc +
# pak4-textures. pak4-textures.pk3 was added because its absence was the
# root cause of a user-reported bug (every wall/floor in oa_dm1 rendered as
# the missing-texture white/black placeholder; ZERO of oa_dm1's 37 referenced
# textures exist in the old 3-pak set). See build-mpkg.sh header for the full
# measurement (both reasons the #607 comment gave for leaving pak4 out are
# resolved by later kernel/App-Store work, re-measured live before shipping
# this change, not assumed) rather than repeating it here.
OPENARENA -> /APPS/OPENARENA
ui.qvm -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/vm/ui.qvm
cgame.qvm -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/vm/cgame.qvm
qagame.qvm -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/vm/qagame.qvm
default.cfg -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/default.cfg
pak0.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak0.pk3
pak1-maps.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak1-maps.pk3
pak6-misc.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak6-misc.pk3
pak4-textures.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak4-textures.pk3
--- END
=== PKG openarena
--- MEMBERS
openarena
openarena/pak1-maps.pk3
openarena/pak0.pk3
openarena/pak6-misc.pk3
openarena/ui.qvm
openarena/cgame.qvm
openarena/INSTALL
openarena/OPENARENA
openarena/qagame.qvm
openarena/default.cfg
--- INSTALL
# INSTALL manifest for the OpenArena App Store package (task #568 M5 / #607).
# Format: "src -> /dest" (one payload file per line), the convention
# appstore/main.c install_pkg() already parses (it splits each line on "->",
# looks up the payload entry named "<id>/<src>" inside this .mpkg, and
# pkg_write()s it to the absolute dest path, mkdir ing parents as needed).
#
# fs_basepath (read-only installed game data, root-owned by the installer,
# never created at runtime by the engine itself, see #569) vs fs_homepath (the
# interactive user own writable profile, resolved at runtime by
# sys_maytera.c Sys_DefaultHomePath(), NOT part of this package) is the split
# task #568 M5 implements; this manifest only ever writes into /APPS (the
# binary) and /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa (the read-only data plus the built .qvm
# modules), matching that design.
#
# Pak set: the reduced 3-pak configuration (pak0 + pak1-maps + pak6-misc) that
# docs/OPENARENA_PORT_STATE.md records as the one used for every live
# verification of this port. See build-mpkg.sh header for why the full 9-pak
# set is not shipped (measured FS_Startup out-of-memory + client unpack heap
# ceiling), stated there rather than repeated here.
OPENARENA -> /APPS/OPENARENA
ui.qvm -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/vm/ui.qvm
cgame.qvm -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/vm/cgame.qvm
qagame.qvm -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/vm/qagame.qvm
default.cfg -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/default.cfg
pak0.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak0.pk3
pak1-maps.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak1-maps.pk3
pak6-misc.pk3 -> /GAMES/OPENARENA/baseoa/pak6-misc.pk3
--- END
